mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM supply_inventory_movement WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT m.id, m.item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.category_id AS item_category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.movement_type, m.qty, m.stock_after, m.claim_id, m.claim_line_id, m.operator_user_id, m.applicant_user_id, m.remark, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM supply_inventory_movement m INNER JOIN supply_item i ON i.id = m.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN supply_category c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE m.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.category_id AS item_category_id, c.name AS category_name, i.stock_qty, i.locked_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type = 'OUTBOUND' THEN m.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outbound_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type = 'INBOUND' THEN m.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inbound_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type = 'ADJUST' THEN m.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS adjust_qty FROM supply_item i LEFT JOIN supply_category c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN supply_inventory_movement m ON m.item_id = i.id AND m.created_at >= #{from} WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND (#{categoryId} = 0 OR i.category_id = #{categoryId}) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.category_id, c.name, i.stock_qty, i.locked_qty HAVING outbound_qty > 0 OR inbound_qty > 0 OR adjust_qty > 0 ORDER BY outbound_qty DESC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.applicant_user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.claim_id) AS claim_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type = 'OUTBOUND' THEN m.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outbound_qty, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(m.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_at FROM supply_inventory_movement m WHERE m.applicant_user_id IS NOT NULL AND m.applicant_user_id <> '' AND m.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY m.applicant_user_id HAVING outbound_qty > 0 ORDER BY outbound_qty DESC, last_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
